note: Assets register — run like a library. Every physical item is ONE row with its own tag (asset_id); quantities are never typed, they are COUNTED from the rows (Asset Stock), so issued + available + under repair always adds up. A new item starts in `initial_status`; only the moves below change a status (Asset Issue & Returns issues and takes back; Asset Stock repairs, restocks and retires). A return in a condition named in `by_condition` goes there instead of back on the shelf: damaged → under repair, lost → lost. `retired` is hidden by the register like every retired row. `recovery_statuses` is what happened to an amount charged on a damaged/lost return. Edit the words here, never the PHP.
recovery_statuses: Pending - Deduct in Next Pay Cycle

recovery_payroll.status: Pending - Deduct in Next Pay Cycle
recovery_payroll.note: Owner, 22 Oct 2026: a Damaged/Lost return with this recovery status puts the recovery amount into the Deductions Ledger (type Asset Damage Recovery, status Pending) for the employee's next pay cycle — the first month from the return date that has no payroll run yet. Payroll reads it as an Other Deduction titled Asset Damage Recovery (config/payroll-inputs.json). Changing the recovery status later (Paid / Waived off / On hold) waives that pending deduction; changing the amount updates it.

reissue_note: Issuing one of these categories to an employee who already holds one asks for confirmation first (Asset Issue & Returns), and is refused without it.

recovery_settled.note: A Damaged or Lost return is SETTLED when its final status is one of `resolutions` and, if a recovery amount was charged, its recovery status is one of `statuses`. Until then it holds the employee's Exit clearance and FnF (owner, 29 Sep).

issue_within_note: A unit can only be issued to an employee of the same company and branch: every column listed in `issue_within` must match between the asset and the employee. Asset Issue & Returns lists only that employee's stock; the server refuses the rest. Remove a column to relax the rule.

transfer.note: Asset Stock → Transfer moves units in these statuses to another company / branch. An issued unit is returned first; lost and retired units stay where they are.
